caseName: Blanton v. Americans United for the Separation of Church & State
caseNameFull: Blanton, Governor of Tennessee v. Americans United for the Separation of Church and State

opinions.text:
D. C. M. D.Tenn. Application for stay, presented to Mr. Justice Stewart, *918and by him referred to the Court, granted pending final disposition on. appeal in this Court.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.*
